result.title: Neural Image Compression with Internal-External Prior Fusion and Alignment
result.comment: IEEE International Conference on Visual Communications and Image Processing 2026 (VCIP 2026)
result.summary: Existing context models for learned image com- pression rely primarily on internal priors from the current image, overlooking common patterns and typical textures shared across natural images. To address this limitation, we propose an Internal-External Prior Fusion-Alignment (IE-PFA) context model built upon quadtree spatial-channel joint modeling, where a learnable dictionary shared by the encoder and decoder serves as an external prior. Specifically, an RWKV-based Spatial- Channel Prior Fusion (RSCPF) module efficiently fuses inter- nal and external priors along spatial and channel dimensions with linear complexity, while a training-only Self-Distilled Prior Alignment (SDPA) mechanism aligns them without inference overhead. Moreover, our model supports variable-rate coding over 64 quality levels within a single network and is accelerated by custom CUDA operators. Experiments on seven benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art rate-distortion performance, achiev- ing an average BD-Rate saving of 21.65% over VTM-22.0-Intra, with only 29.9M parameters and the fastest coding speed among advanced neural codecs (61 ms encoding and 52 ms decoding). Code is available at https://github.com/stcnjtech/DCVC-X-Intra.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 IE-PFA 上下文模型：以编解码共享的可学习字典作为外部先验，用基于 RWKV 的空间-通道先验融合模块与仅训练期生效的自蒸馏对齐机制整合内外先验，在单一网络内支持 64 档变码率图像压缩。
AI.relevance_reason: 可学习字典式外部先验与内部上下文融合、以及训练期对齐以避免推理开销的做法，可能可供核查如何向 LVR 的 latent 状态注入共享视觉先验并施加辅助监督；但该工作只面向压缩的码率-失真，不涉及推理决策与证据筛选，借鉴性需进一步判断。
